thread:
Sam: quick async — proposing a small change to chat/completions messages schema. idea: make tool/function-call args order-preserving and add a streaming 'final' flag on toolcall deltas to signal closure. goal is compat-first but easier reassembly for streaming clients. need +1s and any risks i missed.

Maya: can you paste the minimal diff? curious about nullable roles + ordering implications.

Sam: sure, minimal example of proposed shape:
```json
{
  \"role\": \"assistant\",
  \"content\": null,
  \"tool_call\": {
    \"name\": \"lookup\",
    \"args\": [
      { \"name\": \"user_id\", \"value\": \"u-123\" },
      { \"name\": \"limit\", \"value\": 10 }
    ],
    \"streaming\": true
  },
  \"meta\": { \"schema\": \"v2\" }
}
```
This replaces a plain object map for args with an array-of-kv to preserve order. streaming deltas would include partial arg pieces and a `final: true` on the last delta chunk.

Jules: array-of-kv seems reasonable for deterministic reassembly. question: will this break SDK helpers that expect a map? we should provide server-side adapter.

Irene: +1 for adapter. also: ensure 'final' is emitted exactly once per toolcall and that we have tests for midstream truncation. we had flakiness previously when two toolcalls interleaved.

Maya: perf note — arrays slightly bigger on wire, but negligible vs tokens. we should add a migration/lint rule and document in convo contract. Also, how long do we accept the old args-as-object shape?

dev-bot: CI: convo-contract-tests failed on PR #8421 — reassembly unit test flaked on partial toolcall interleave. (build: https://ci/redwood/8421)

Sam: good catch from CI. plan: server will accept both shapes for now, and set message.meta.migrated=true when we convert object->array so we can track usage. also emit a deprecation warning header in responses. rollout window proposal: accept both for 2 weeks, warn, then 3 months deprecate.

Jules: caution: converting object->array by sorting keys is not ideal (loses original order intent). rely on JSON insertion order from parser if available, and document that clients must migrate to array to guarantee order. if parser insertion-order is not stable across parsers, we need to require explicit schema version.

Irene: option: include meta.schema on the root message (we used a similar approach in streams-alpha). consumers mostly respected it when present. propose meta.schema = "v2" for the new format. server accepts schema v1 or missing (legacy) and v2 array shape.

Maya: sounds good. ops: rollout plan should include console metric for migrated messages and a short statuspage notice before hard deprecate. add migration guide in docs and SDK adapters.

Sam: action items I'll take:
- implement parser that accepts object or array, but annotate migrated messages with meta.migrated=true
- add `final` boolean for streaming toolcall deltas and ensure it's emitted once
- add unit/integration tests for reassembly with interleaved toolcalls + final flag
- add telemetry: migrated_count and final_flag_missing_count
- update docs and release notes, and add a short lint rule in convo-contract-lint
I'll open PR and ping SDK owners once ready.

Jules: also add a test simulating slow clients (drop last delta) so we can ensure graceful cleanup.

Irene: add console alert if migrated_count spikes (could indicate broken clients).

Maya: +1. please include one-liner for release notes: "Convo: introduce ordered toolcall args (v2) and streaming final flag; server accepts legacy args for a limited rollout."

Sam: thanks — will do. tagging folks: @Jules @Irene @Maya. will post PR link here when it's up. :thumbsup:
